# datadog_integration_snowflake_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Snowflake integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Snowflake integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Snowflake integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the Snowflake integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Snowflake, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `snowflake_integration_account_private_key_auth` (Attributes) The RSA key pair authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--snowflake_integration_account_private_key_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--snowflake_integration_account_private_key_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.snowflake_integration_account_private_key_auth`

Required:

- `private_key_name` (String) Name that distinguishes this private key from other keys in Datadog.
- `private_key_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The private key, in PEM format. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `private_key_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for private_key_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `snowflake_private_key`. Defaults to `"snowflake_private_key"`.
- `private_key_passphrase_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Passphrase that decrypts the private key. Provide it only when the key is encrypted. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `private_key_passphrase_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for private_key_passphrase_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `snowflake_account_identifier` (String) Identifier of the Snowflake account being monitored.
- `username` (String) Snowflake user Datadog authenticates as.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `snowflake_account_usage_metrics` (Attributes) Account-level usage metrics read from the Snowflake `ACCOUNT_USAGE` schema, covering storage usage, credit consumption, and query activity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_account_usage_metrics))
- `snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics` (Attributes) Cost data aggregated from the Snowflake `ORGANIZATION_USAGE` schema. Requires [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/) to be set up for your organization, and the ORGANIZATION_BILLING_VIEWER database role on the Snowflake role; without both this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics))
- `snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring` (Attributes) Data Observability, which collects lineage and data quality information from your Snowflake databases so you can explore how data flows and detect and resolve quality issues. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring))
- `snowflake_event_table_logs` (Attributes) Records from your Snowflake event tables, used to monitor application behavior and identify issues. `enabled` turns the dataflow on and off as a whole, and the per-record-type toggles in `settings` select which kinds of record it collects while it is on. The Snowflake role needs usage granted on the database, the schema, and the event table itself; without those grants this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_event_table_logs))
- `snowflake_organization_usage_metrics` (Attributes) Organization-level usage metrics read from the Snowflake `ORGANIZATION_USAGE` schema, covering the credit consumption of every account in the organization and the history of data transferred out of Snowflake. Reading that schema requires the ORGADMIN role; without it this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_organization_usage_metrics))
- `snowflake_query_history_logs` (Attributes) Per-query logs that let you identify long-running, poorly performing, and expensive queries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_query_history_logs))
- `snowflake_security_logs` (Attributes) Security logs from the Snowflake `ACCOUNT_USAGE` schema, for analyzing the security of your Snowflake account and running threat detection with [Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_security_logs))
- `snowflake_task_history_logs` (Attributes) Execution logs for your scheduled Snowflake tasks, covering start time, end time, status, and any error message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_task_history_logs))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_account_usage_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_account_usage_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the account usage metrics dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_account_usage_metrics--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_account_usage_metrics--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_account_usage_metrics.settings`

Optional:

- `account_usage_metrics_aggregate_last_24h` (Boolean) The period each metric aggregates over. When `true`, metrics aggregate the past 24 hours on a rolling basis; when `false`, they aggregate the current day so far.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Cloud Cost Management dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_cloud_cost_metrics.settings`

Optional:

- `query_tags` (String) Snowflake query tags ingested as a comma-separated list of tag names, so that cost data can be broken down by them in Cloud Cost Management.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Data Observability dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_data_observability_quality_monitoring.settings`

Optional:

- `do_table_crawler_cron` (String) Cron expression setting how often Datadog crawls your Snowflake table metadata.
- `sync_snowflake_system_database` (Boolean) Whether metadata from the Snowflake `SNOWFLAKE` system database is included in Data Observability alongside your own databases.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_event_table_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_event_table_logs`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the event table dataflow. Each record type is collected independently so that you can control ingestion costs, and every record type is ingested into Datadog as logs tagged with its `record_type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_event_table_logs--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--snowflake_event_table_logs--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.snowflake_event_table_logs.settings`

Optional:

- `event_table_events_enabled` (Boolean) Whether records with a `record_type` of `event` are collected.
- `event_table_logs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether records with a `record_type` of `log` are collected.
- `event_table_logs_interval_min` (Number) How often event table records are collected, in minutes.
- `event_table_span_events_enabled` (Boolean) Whether records with a `record_type` of `span_event` are collected.
- `event_table_spans_enabled` (Boolean) Whether records with a `record_type` of `span` are collected.
